title: Platform standup notes - 2026-03-26
content:
Attendees: Aisha, Ben, Sofia, Marcus, Priya (remote)

Quick notes (informal):
- Check-in mostly about control-plane rollout for tenant routing + the quota enforcement changes we shipped yesterday. Small burst of increased 429s overnight for a subset of keys - looks correlated with new quota window logic.
- Reproduced locally: quota-window edge case when requests span a lease boundary (INF-3904). Working hypothesis: race in windows map when update and check happen concurrently.

Yesterday/Done:
- Aisha: pushed hotfix to quota window (INF-3904) and rolled to staging. Verified that unit tests now cover window boundary; staging looks clean for 6 hours. Open follow-up to add more fuzz tests.
- Ben: finished routing policy refactor for region-fallbacks; added metrics for routing decisions (route_decision.*). Deployed to canary (5% traffic) without obvious latency impact.
- Sofia: investigated control-plane auth token expiry mismatch; found that token TTLs issued by the auth service were 2s shorter than the control-plane expect due to clock skew on one node. Added NTP sync check to bootstrap scripts.
- Marcus: queued PR for better cache invalidation on control-plane when model variants are rolled (PR#784).
- Priya: ran the daily capacity check and updated Dedicated pool sizing doc for next week.

Today/Planned:
- Aisha: monitor quota hotfix on prod for another 24h, start draft for postmortem if any regression appears. Add fuzz tests to INF-3904 branch.
- Ben: increase canary to 20% if no regressions; wire up alert for route_decision anomalies (high fallback rate).
- Sofia: finish auth bootstrap NTP changes and deploy; add a dashboard panel for token expiry mismatch counts.
- Marcus: follow up on PR#784 comments, add a small e2e that exercises cache invalidation on variant rollout.
- Priya: run tabletop with SRE about Dedicated pool autoscaling policy changes next Wed.

Blockers/Risks:
- Quotas: still risk of short-lived 429s during peak if the race isn't fully fixed. Need more load testing simulating lease boundary crossings. Priority: high until we get 48h clean on prod.
- Routing: fallback rate on EU->US routing is slightly higher than baseline (0.8% -> 1.6%). Ben to investigate policy thresholds. If it keeps trending, may need temporary increase in reserved capacity for EU region.
- Auth: one remaining node with stale NTP config in staging; blocked on infra access ticket.

Action items:
- Aisha: create postmortem draft if any 429 spikes appear, link INF-3904 and include timeline (due asap).
- Ben: add alert for route_decision.fallback_rate > 1.2% over 15m and increase canary to 20% if green. Link: JIRA-INF-3921.
- Sofia: push NTP bootstrap change and add token-expiry panel to console (eta: EOD).
- Marcus: address PR comments and add e2e; aim to merge by tomorrow.
- Priya: set up tabletop invite for SRE + Dedicated owners, include runbook review.

Decisions made:
- Hold off on global rollback for quota change; prefer targeted hotfix + extended monitoring. Rollback only if >2% of requests get 429s for 30m.
- Increase routing canary gradually (5->20%) unless fallback alert fires.

Notes/Questions to follow up:
- Should we add a small server-side time drift check into the control-plane agent to avoid auth TTL mismatches? Sofia to propose minimal change.
- Need proposal for quota enforcement scaling: consider moving to token-bucket per-tenant with approximate counters to reduce contention at lease boundaries. Aisha to sketch design.

Incidents reference:
- INF-3904: quota-window race - hotfix deployed to staging (rolled to prod with caution).
- INF-3921: routing fallback anomalies - investigation in progress.

Misc/FYI:
- Observability: new metric route_decision.latency.p95 is now emitted in canary - early numbers look good.
- Docs: updated "dedicated-pool-sizing.md" in Drive (Priya) - link in Confluence page.
- Small TODO: update runbook section about quota-window issues with steps to validate fix (Aisha).

Notes to self (choppy):
- add more fuzzing around lease boundary in quota tests
- check memory usage for routing table after yesterday's refactor (Ben)
- ask infra team for access to staging node with bad NTP
- double-check token TTL math in auth lib (off-by-one possibility)

Next standup: 2026-03-27 09:30 PT
